sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 143)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, Bud Collyer as the Man of Steel foiling undersea pirates in *The Adventures of Superman* for Kellogg's Pep, Gene Autry's Wonder Horse Champion in *The Mystery of the Lost Treasure* for Post's Cereals, Sunday and Lord Henry in *Our Gal Sunday* for Anacin, two authentic police procedurals on *Official Detective*, and Johnny O'Brien and Helen Troy in early radio sitcom pioneer *Cecil and Sally* (1930–1955):
